verdict.rationale: TypeSafe has a first-party interactive Playground where users paste state and run Noul/Choice/Score questions against the API. Its docs include an SDK API reference and copyable cURL/Python/JavaScript examples, for example on the models endpoint. However, the evidence does not show the API reference itself being interactive (no try-it-now console in the reference pages), and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: in-reference runnable 'try it' examples, a published OpenAPI spec for interactive explorers, and independent hands-on confirmation of the interactive reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
